ShrubSign 3.3.1 improves detection of completed installations, including same-build reinstalls, and reduces work during signing and local IPA packaging.

### Installation

- ShrubSign can confirm a fresh install, a version update, or a same-build reinstall when iOS exposes the relevant app registration. Confirmed installs show **Installed · 100%** and a **Done** button.
- A stalled percentage gives way to **Checking installation**. If ShrubSign can’t confirm the result, you can check again or mark it installed after opening the app from your Home Screen.
- Automatic starts with trusted Fully Local and can fall back to Semi Local if local setup fails. Server installs use uncompressed packaging by default. Explicit compression settings still apply, and uncompressed packages may be larger.

### Signing and export

- Uses copy-on-write bundle staging where supported, keeps the signing work at user-initiated priority, and avoids rewriting an unchanged Info.plist.
- Reports false returns and errors from the signing engine. Certificate-signed IPAs retain the provisioning profile they need for installation.
- Exporting the same app twice in the same second uses a distinct filename.
